title: Cost Management and Budgets
description: Monitor Azure spending, set budgets, and optimize costs for ASP.NET Core workloads.

data.text: Azure costs can grow quickly without visibility. Azure Cost Management and budgets help you track spending, set alerts, and optimize resources without surprise bills.
Key Cost Drivers for ASP.NET Core Apps

items: **App Service plan** — pay for VM time even when the app is idle
**Azure SQL DTU or vCore** — scales independently from the app
**Data egress** — moving data out of Azure can become expensive
**Application Insights** — high telemetry volume increases ingestion costs

data.title: Create a budget with Azure CLI
data.content: Set a monthly budget and alert threshold for the resource group.
data.code:
az consumption budget create \
  --budget-name aspnet-course-budget \
  --resource-group azure-for-aspnet-rg \
  --amount 50 \
  --time-grain Monthly \
  --start-date 2026-10-01 \
  --end-date 2027-10-01 \
  --notification-key emails \
  --notification-enabled true \
  --threshold 80 \
  --contact-emails you@example.com

rows: Stop or scale down non-production slots during off-hours
Use serverless or pause dev databases
Move older files to Cool or Archive tier
Use Basic tier for non-critical caching
Set daily caps and sample telemetry

data.title: Cost alerts
data.text: Create alerts at 50%, 80%, and 100% of budget so you are notified before charges accumulate.

data.title: Create a cost budget and alert
data.description: Protect yourself from unexpected Azure charges during this course.
steps: Open the Azure Cost Management + Billing blade
Create a budget of $25 for the `azure-for-aspnet-rg` resource group
Review the cost analysis for the current month
data.expectedOutcome: You have an active budget with email alerts and understand which resources cost the most.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Azure Cost Management provides budgets, alerts, and cost analysis
Set budgets early to avoid surprise charges
App Service and Azure SQL are usually the largest cost drivers
Use dev/test pricing and auto-shutdown for non-production environments
data.takeaway: Cost management is part of running production apps on Azure. Budgets and alerts keep learning and experimentation affordable.
